meta.title: Docs
meta.description: Short guides to Mewvo: getting started for staff, how warnings escalate, how appeals work and using the dashboard.

hub.title: Guides
hub.lead: How Mewvo works, step by step. For every command members can use, see [Commands](/commands).

setup.title: Set up Mewvo in 10 minutes
setup.summary: For the server owner: the few settings Mewvo needs, in order, on the dashboard.
setup.intro: You need the **Administrator** permission in the server. Everything below is done on the dashboard, in your browser. You do not need to type any commands.

open.title: 1. Open the dashboard
open.text: Go to the [dashboard]({dashboard}) and log in with Discord. Mewvo only asks Discord who you are. It does not see your email or your messages.

steps.title: 2. Follow "Setup step by step"
steps.text: On the Overview page, press **Set up Mewvo step by step**. It shows one setting at a time, says why it matters, and opens the right page. Skip anything you do not need. The most important three are:
steps.modLog: **Mod log channel**: a staff-only channel where Mewvo writes down every warning, mute, kick and ban.
steps.mutedRole: **Muted role**: Mewvo makes it by itself the first time someone is muted, so you can leave it.
steps.appealsCategory: **Appeals category**: where Mewvo opens a private channel when a member asks to have a punishment lifted.

rules.title: 3. Write your rules
rules.text: On the **Rules** page, add your server rules. They show on a web page, and every punishment message names the rule that was broken.

automod.title: 4. Check automod
automod.text: On the **Automod** page you choose what automod does. If you are not sure yet, pick **Report only (don't delete)**: automod then only tells staff what it would have done, and nothing happens to anyone until a staff member agrees. Switch to **Act** when you trust it.

try.title: 5. Try it on yourself
try.text: In Discord, run `/test`. Mewvo sends you the exact message a member would get for a warning or a ban. Nothing is done to anyone.

next.title: Next
next.text: The sidebar shows the main pages. Press **Show all pages** at the bottom to see everything. If a word is new to you, open **Words explained** in the sidebar. Questions? Ask in {support}.

gettingStarted.title: Getting started for staff
gettingStarted.summary: Who can use what, your first enforcement action, and the commands you’ll use every week.

access.title: Who can do what
access.text: Everyday commands (help, rank, leaderboard, fun, to-do lists, reports and so on) are open to every member. Anything that moderates, changes settings, posts as the bot, affects other members or moves currency needs the **Administrator** role. The check runs every time a command or button is used, not only when it is first opened.
access.denied: Members without Administrator who try a staff command are told so and pointed to the channel where they can request a role.

firstAction.title: Your first action
firstAction.run: Run `/enforcements user:@member`. The panel shows the member’s account age, time in the server, counted warnings, warning stage (0 to 3), any active punishment and their last cases. Only you can see it.
firstAction.action: Press the action: **Ban**, **Kick**, **Mute** or **Warn** (or **Unban**, **Unmute**, **Remove warn** when they apply).
firstAction.reason: Choose a prebuilt reason or **Custom…** and type one.
firstAction.duration: For a mute, give a duration such as `30m`, `24h`, `7d` or `1mo`. For a ban, the same, or leave it blank for a permanent ban.
firstAction.after: The member gets a DM before a kick or ban happens. If the DM can’t be delivered, the action still goes ahead and you are told. The panel expires after 15 minutes; run the command again if it does.

everyWeek.title: Commands you’ll use
everyWeek.case: Search cases, edit a reason or duration, remove a case given by mistake (it stops counting), see its history, attach evidence.
everyWeek.appeals: Accept or deny an appeal by case code, with a note.
everyWeek.test: Sends you the exact DM a member would get. Nothing is done to anyone.
everyWeek.warnMessageText: Right-click a message, then Apps: warns the author with the message attached.

limits.title: Limits that protect the server
limits.text: Mewvo refuses to act on the server owner, the bot, yourself, or anyone whose highest role is equal to or above yours. If one moderator bans or kicks more than 5 members in 10 minutes, they are blocked for an hour and the owner is told.

warnings.title: How warnings and bans escalate
warnings.summary: The warning ladder: three warnings, then 7 days, 30 days and a permanent ban.
warnings.intro: Every member has a ladder in each server. It starts at level 0 with no warnings, and it never resets on its own.

steps.title: The steps
steps.first: **Warnings 1 and 2** are a DM: “Warning 1 of 3” and “Warning 2 of 3”.
steps.third: **Warning 3** is an automatic 7-day ban. The member is now at level 1.
steps.next: After they return, the **next warning** is an automatic 30-day ban (level 2).
steps.last: The **warning after that** is a permanent ban (level 3). It can be appealed for 6 months. After that, or after a denied appeal, it can no longer be appealed.

warnings.dmCaption: The DM for the automatic ban at warning 3. Appealing this code also removes the warning that caused it.

changes.title: What changes the ladder
changes.appeal: Accepted appeal of a ladder ban
changes.appealText: Lowers the level by one, never below 0.
changes.voidText: For a case given by mistake. It stays on record but no longer counts.
changes.importedText: Shown as history only. They don’t count.

warnings.standing: Members can check where they are with **My record** on the appeal panel.

appeals.title: Appeals: how they work
appeals.summary: Where to appeal, what the form asks, who decides and how long it takes to try again.

where.title: Where to appeal
where.text: Every punishment DM has the appeal link, or says it can’t be appealed. The appeal panel has three buttons: **Appeal**, **My appeals** and **My record**. Muted or warned members use the panel in the main server. Banned members use the one in {support}, which they can still reach after a ban.

form.title: The form
form.moreText: Optional, anything else staff should know.

after.title: What happens next
after.banKick: **Ban and kick appeals** open a channel in the support server with you in it, so staff can ask questions.
after.muteWarn: **Mute and warning appeals** are reviewed by staff in the main server.
after.decision: The administrators decide. You get the decision by DM. An accepted appeal lifts what is still active and, for bans and kicks, comes with a one-time invite back.

limits.title: Limits
limits.cooldown: After a denial, wait 7 days before appealing the same case again.
limits.window: Bans and mutes can be appealed while they last. Warnings and kicks within 30 days.
limits.unappealable: Some cases can’t be appealed, for example a permanent ladder ban after 6 months. The DM says so.

usingTheDashboard.title: Using the dashboard
usingTheDashboard.summary: Signing in, the four areas of the sidebar, and where changes are recorded.

signIn.title: Signing in
signIn.text: Open the dashboard and log in with Discord. Mewvo only asks Discord who you are (`identify`). You need the Administrator role in the server; it is checked again on every page and every save. A server can also give a moderator role view access to the moderation pages.
signIn.textLink: Open [the dashboard]({dashboard}) and log in with Discord. Mewvo only asks Discord who you are (`identify`). You need the Administrator role in the server; it is checked again on every page and every save. A server can also give a moderator role view access to the moderation pages.

usingTheDashboard.shotAlt: The Cases page of the Mewvo dashboard: filters for member, moderator, type, status, text and dates above a table of cases with code, type, member, moderator, reason, date and status.

areas.title: The four areas
areas.moderateText: Overview (what needs you first), Inbox, Members, Banned, Cases, Appeals, Keep apart, Staff and Channel tools.
areas.communityText: Tickets and modmail, Welcome and goodbye, Leveling, Reaction roles, Messages, Giveaways, Birthdays, Applications, Community and Join to create.
areas.setupText: Automod, Enforcement and appeals, Logging, Verification, Counters and the Support server.
areas.botText: All modules, Commands and the Audit log.

changes.title: Changes and the audit log
changes.text: Settings are shown as rows; change one and save. Every change is written to the audit log: who changed which setting, from what, to what. Actions such as bans from the Members page use the same rules as the commands, including the DM and the safety checks.
changes.phones: The dashboard works on phones too, with a tab bar at the bottom, and has five themes in the account menu (Light, Dark, Dim, High contrast, or the same as your device).
